purpose: Interface and applicability audit of pinned upstream BackdoorBench primitives on the shared BloodMNIST checkpoint-drift representation.

requirements: All six development victims meet the frozen CA/ASR eligibility thresholds.
Every method completes without exception or non-finite exposed score.
Candidate and reference counts match the frozen pool definition.
A repeated SCAn call on the first configuration returns identical flags and scores.
Receipts identify the pinned upstream commit, symbol and all decision parameters.

interpretation_constraints: This is a feature-level adapter audit, not a claim of bit-identical end-to-end BackdoorBench execution.
SPECTRE oracle-budget variants must be labelled as advantaged baselines.
SCAn conclusions on a binary task must explicitly discuss its across-class anomaly-score degeneracy.
A runtime-only SciPy compatibility alias from removed sym_pos=True to assume_a='pos' is permitted and must be recorded; it does not change the requested positive-definite solve.
